specification.objective: Improve proper WIS with causally resolved outcome feedback, keeping the existing HGB median exactly. No point-MAE or conformal-coverage guarantee.

specification.objective_math: Pinball gradient at actually issued quantile is 1{Y<=q_issued}-tau (valid subgradient including ties). On a resolved timestamp/context batch update eight nonmedian offsets theta<-(1-eta*lambda)*theta+eta*mean(tau-1{Y<=q_issued}). eta has unitsseconds, lambda reciprocalseconds. This is a delayed regularized quantile-feedback heuristic; after forecast projection it is not a guarantee of gradient descent in raw offsets or of conformal coverage.
specification.forecast: Apply current context offsets to static eightquantiles, preserve staticmedian, project loweroffsets<=0/sort and upperoffsets>=0/sort. Store these actually issued coherent quantiles immutably for later feedback. No gradient recomputed against updated quantiles.
specification.timing: Reset all state per race. Sort actions by actual raw issued_at_timestamp and target_timestamp. Issue ALLrows at timestamp before resolving ANYlabel at same timestamp, so all feedback is strictly prior for peers and owncar. Multiple labels resolving simultaneously in a context update atomically by mean gradient. Context uses compound known at originalissuance; resolved target cannot choosecontext. Never filter on target_same_stint,outcome value or futureavailability; every inherited scored issuance is retained. The inherited retrospectively matched originaleligiblepopulation remains its known limitation.
specification.contexts: race_global pools all currently available resolved forecasts in the same race; race_compound pools by compound recorded at issuance within the race. No driver/position/targetcontext tuning.
